close_reason: Deferred from kith — FileNode is a hearth feature (shared workspace file storage). kith's P2P model uses attachments, not shared folders. Will implement in hearth when that project starts.
description: Implement urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:filenode capability per draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00. Associates a FileNode tree with each Space via the urn:jmap:chat:filenode:space role and spaceId extension property. Maps Space roles to FileNode access (view→read, send→create, manage_channels→delete, manage_space→admin). Extends Attachment with optional filenodeId and thumbnailBlobId fields for linking message attachments to Space files. Handles Space deletion cascading to file tree (with optional grace period).
title: JMAP Chat FileNode: Space-scoped file storage
